non_claims: furofuran versus monotetrahydrofuran (lariciresinol-type) lignans is not resolved by these ions
stereoisomers such as pinoresinol and epipinoresinol are not resolved

glycosides are outside the precursor population: both ions under a glucoside precursor are shown only for pinoresinol 4-O-glucoside in TQ CAD (Ricci 2008 Fig. 4a), whose QIT MS2 gives neither, and no medioresinol or syringaresinol glycoside shows the pair
pinoresinol [M+CH3COO]- and syringaresinol [M-H]- have one composition (417.1555), so the reported aglycone and adduct hypothesis can be the wrong one; the motif is the same

notes: Phenolic furofuran aglycones give the guaiacyl 151 or syringyl 181 cleavage anion and its CH3 radical loss 136 or 166 (Eklund 2008 ion-trap MS2; Ricci 2008); the second ion is a radical-loss product of the first, so one cleavage is shown and the rule is not measured.

competitors.note: Matairesinol is an isomer of pinoresinol; its [M-H]- loses CO2 and a methyl radical instead of giving the aryl cleavage anion (Eklund 2008).
Dehydrodiconiferyl alcohol (8-5' phenylcoumaran, C20H22O6) is an isomer of pinoresinol; no cited source reports its negative-mode ions, so it is declared for the competitor FPR.

terms.note: Side-chain cleavage anion of the hypothesised aryl units: guaiacyl C8H7O3- 151.0401, syringyl C9H9O4- 181.0506 (nominal in the sources; formula from the drawn ion).
Methyl-radical loss from the cleavage anion: C7H4O3 radical anion 136.0166, C8H6O4 radical anion 166.0272 (nominal in the sources).
